# Network360 Core Team

Network360 now has a new module, Look up a Group. Now, searches for your desired provider group will be easy!  This release also includes various fixes. 

# Enhancements

## Look up a Group

### Criteria Page

![Look up a Group Criteria Page](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-criteria-page.png "Look up a Group Criteria Page")

In this new module, you can search for a provider group by inputting the group’s name or ID.  You can also include the providers’ specialties and geography to narrow your search.  The provider specialties refer to the specialties of the providers associated with the group. 

To see results you can use two different methods.  

1. You can use the type ahead feature of the Group Name or ID field to select a group from the dropdown list.  When you use this method, clicking the group’s name in the dropdown will bring you to your selected group’s profile page.
2. You can enter your search criteria and then click the Go button.  The search results will appear.   

### Search Results

![Look up a Group Search Results page](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-results-page.png "Look up a Group Search Results page")

The search results list the groups which best match your search criteria.  The results will match the entered name to either the preferred group name or alternate name.

On the Search Results page, to see the group profile page, click on the linked preferred group name.  To see the alternate names, click the linked “Other Names” in the Alternate Name column.    To see the specialties of the providers associated with the group, click the link in the Provider Specialties column.  The office count displays the number of offices which meet the search criteria and the total number of the group’s offices. 

## Left Sidebar Navigation

### Broker Tools Menu

Now, the modules are listed in alphabetical order. 

![Broker Tools Menu](/cms/cms-assets/media/broker-tools-menu.png "Broker Tools Menu")

### Recruitment & Research Menu

Now the modules are listed in alphabetical order.

![Recruitment & Research Menu](/cms/cms-assets/media/recruitment-research-menu.png "Recruitment & Research Menu")

# Fixes

## Compare Networks

Fixed an issue where the PDF export was missing some network names on the Volatility Details page. Now, all the network names show appropriately.

Fixed an issue where (in certain circumstances) the Network Comparison Specialty Group Details chart did not render correctly in the PDF.  Now, the chart renders correctly. 

## My Things

Now, when you use the mobile menu (which appears when the browser is resized to be small) and click on My Network Rankings, you will no longer see an error message.
